verdict.rationale: Vapi provides dedicated testing tooling—Voice Test Suites and Evals (mock conversations, automated validation) explicitly designed to 'validate your agents work correctly before production'—plus CLI support for switching between organizations/environments and forwarding webhooks to a local server for debugging, all of which let a user test without touching production data or calls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that test/sandbox data is fully isolated from production, and no explicit 'sandbox environment' terminology or dedicated non-prod org/workspace concept beyond generic environment switching.
